correctness.rationale: PASS. Rebuilt GP(8,3) from the specified 24 edges and the unordered Abrams cubical model (C0,C1,C2)=(120,336,228); the n=2 subdivision conditions hold (every essential-vertex path has at least one edge and cycles have at least three). Regenerated all 24 simple girth-six cycles and all 60 disjoint pairs. Their product two-chains have zero boundary. Recomputed independently rank(d2,F3)=208 and rank(d2,F2)=207, and the listed 20-by-20 square-coordinate minor on the stated shortest-cycle tori is exactly det -1. Since the 20 primitive torus cycles lie in ker(d2) of rational rank 20 and have an integral unit minor, they form a full integral basis (not merely a rational spanning set). Independently computed full integral Smith form of d2: 207 unit factors, one factor 2, giving H1=Z^9⊕Z/2 by connectedness and H2=Z^20. Graph automorphism 96 and torus-orbit sizes 12/48 are supported by source symmetry code/outputs and its full graph-automorphism enumeration, rather than being inferred from a partial sample.
